lines.text: 小雨躺在床上，揉着手腕说：“你知道吗？今天我拍了那么多照片，没有一张里有我。”
lines.py: Xiǎo yǔ tǎng zài chuáng shàng, róu zhe shǒu wàn shuō: “nǐ zhī dào ma? jīn tiān wǒ pāi le nà me duō zhào piàn, méi yǒu yì zhāng lǐ yǒu wǒ.”
lines.en: Lying on her bed and rubbing her wrist, Xiaoyu says, "You know what? I took all those photos today, and I'm not in a single one."
